training.fitnessSource: ai_evolve::play_traced: real headless World::advance matches on the same Rust core; no scripted or synthetic scores
training.denialNote: Denial fitness is a real geometric metric: a torpedo salvo's straight track must cover the enemy's current course projection inside a 450 m fan corridor, and the report also samples the enemy's observed 90 s course change after that coverage. It is not a hit count.

profiles.name: 帷幄 · 屏护协同
profiles.description: 以屏护与交叉火力为主：驱逐分队卡在敌雷击队与主力之间，炮战保持射界并抢 T 头。

fitness.definition: 120*win + 25*敌沉 - 15*己沉 + 70*(敌损伤率-己损伤率) - 30*友军误击 + 40*己方巡洋存活率 + 20*(1-己损伤率)

shop.fit: 验证 282.6 / 内置 coord 50.2（同 objective 6 场）
shop.risk: 屏护分队被雷击队钉住时炮火会分散，收割慢。

profiles.name: 夜潮 · 雷击突击
profiles.description: 以雷击为主：分队分头绕向敌纵队侧翼，压缩距离后按侧舷角放雷，炮战只做压制。

fitness.definition: 120*win + 25*敌沉 - 15*己沉 + 70*(敌损伤率-己损伤率) - 30*友军误击 + 10*鱼雷命中 + 3*鱼雷发射 + 30*敌损伤率

shop.fit: 验证 217.6 / 内置 torpedo 181.3（同 objective 6 场）
shop.risk: 贴脸后吃交叉火力；雷未中时交换比差。

profiles.name: 铁幕 · 炮战纵队
profiles.description: 以炮战为主：保持远距射界，优先抢占敌纵队的 T 头位置，用交叉火力分散其指挥。

fitness.definition: 120*win + 25*敌沉 - 15*己沉 + 70*(敌损伤率-己损伤率) - 30*友军误击 + 2.5*炮击命中 + 25*敌损伤率 + 20*敌沉

shop.fit: 验证 1692.2 / 内置 gunnery 1094.9（同 objective 6 场）
shop.risk: 被高速雷击队贴到 3 km 内时射界与装填吃亏。

profiles.name: 绞肉 · 近战乱斗
profiles.description: 以近距乱战为主：高航速贴脸，压缩到 3 公里内炮雷混战，低撤退阈值。

fitness.definition: 120*win + 25*敌沉 - 15*己沉 + 70*(敌损伤率-己损伤率) - 30*友军误击 + 1.5*3km内实伤 + 0.3*3km内接敌秒 + 50*敌沉

shop.fit: 验证 822.0 / 内置 torpedo 656.0（3 km 内实伤与接敌秒）
shop.risk: 被远距风筝时打不到人；低撤退阈值会硬吃损伤。

profiles.name: 拖刀 · 远距风筝
profiles.description: 以远距风筝为主：保持 6 公里外射界，边打边退维持射程边缘，高撤退阈值。

fitness.definition: 120*win + 25*敌沉 - 15*己沉 + 70*(敌损伤率-己损伤率) - 30*友军误击 + 1.5*6km外实伤 + 150*射程维持率 + 60*(1-己损伤率) + 40*巡洋存活率

shop.fit: 验证 846.6 / 内置 gunnery 234.3（6 km 外实伤与射程维持）
shop.risk: 被迫近身后射程优势消失，且高撤退会放弃部分战果。

profiles.name: 雷网 · 封走位
profiles.description: 以鱼雷扇面封走位为主：高雷击占比、宽扇面与屏护协同，目标不是命中而是逼敌转向。

fitness.definition: 120*win + 25*敌沉 - 15*己沉 + 70*(敌损伤率-己损伤率) - 30*友军误击 + 30*扇面覆盖预定航路 + 10*被覆盖敌舰 + 0.6*威胁后90秒转向度 + 0.5*扇面宽度 + 2*鱼雷发射 + 8*鱼雷命中

shop.fit: 验证 1200.3 / 内置 torpedo 831.1（扇面覆盖预定航路与威胁后转向）
shop.risk: 封走位不直接转化为命中，单舰收割能力弱。

limitations: Denial measures coverage of the enemy's current course projection inside a 450 m corridor; it does not model the enemy's full intent or future manoeuvres. The observed 90 s course change is reported as behaviour, not as a scripted reward.
Brawler and kiter damage attribution uses the nearest candidate hull to the impact point when a tick has multiple hits; this is a real observed proxy, not an exact per-shooter ledger.
Kiter can hold outside torpedo range and fight with guns only; its objective therefore rewards 6 km+ damage, 6 km+ range keeping and survival rather than torpedo launches.
All six evolved storefront entries remain provisional; prices are 800/900/1000/900/1100/1200 recruit tickets and are not a balance claim.
CAMP-ALLIES-06 exists only as an archived crosswalk entry with no runnable runtime; the kiter unlock uses CAMP-ALLIES-11 and the substitution is recorded in shop.unlockSubstitution.
The new profiles are not added to the ranked/duel AI whitelist; this batch covers exercise/campaign selection and the storefront.

server/battle_pve's runnable Stage enum remains 02/03/11, so the 05/10 unlock progress is exercised by seeded progress in tests and by the local campaign; registering those two stages in the online PvE service is follow-up work.
No UI page was added in this batch; client/src/ai-shop.ts carries the shared six-entry data for the supply/recruit UI owner.
